intro: Luxembourg has more Tour de France winners for its size than any other country.

chapters.title: Cycling
text: Luxembourg riders have won the Tour de France five times: François Faber, Nicolas Frantz twice, Charly Gaul and Andy Schleck.

chapters.title: Olympics
text: Josy Barthel won the 1,500 m at the 1952 Olympics, Luxembourg's only Olympic gold in a sporting event.

keyTerms.meaning: The most famous cycling race in the world.
